subject: maths
question:
The pie chart shows the percentage-wise break up of students in terms of specialisation in Engineering.

Total number of students = 8000

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4380ca29f1a54de2ad3725142b0b9550b475d4753e9be87c5fb4093710406483.png] 

What is the total number of students having specialisation in Operating System, Java and DBMS ?
solution:
%students in operating system=16%

%students in java=22%

% students in DBMS=14%

total % students from above specializations=22+16+14=52%

total % of students from all specialization is 100% that is 8000

so 52% is (8000)/(100)times 52=4160

**The number of students from the above selected specialization is 4160**
